description: Mini-schema for risu-bg-extension target lock files (targets/*.lock.yaml). Enforced at runtime by scripts/lib/lock.mjs. Any lock content this schema cannot prove is a hard error (fail closed), never a warning.

status.doc: verified-local: every file hash was computed from an exact local extraction of this exact upstream version. declared-only: no local source exists; nothing is verifiable and every tool must refuse. partial: some material verified, some declared; tools must refuse.

commit.doc: Full 40-char upstream commit SHA, or null when no upstream git checkout was available to verify it. Never a short hash or a guess.

imageId.doc: Local image config digest (docker inspect Image). A locally built image has no repoDigest; this ID pins the exact local build instead.

repoDigest.doc: Registry manifest digest (docker inspect RepoDigests). Null for local builds or unverified pulls.

valueSchema.doc: sha256 hex digest of the pristine extracted file.

notes.doc: Verified observations, each phrased so it remains true or the lock must be rewritten.

gaps.doc: Source-dependent gaps that remain unverified. Honest reporting; a gap never blocks a lock from being valid, but any gap that touches identity must force status below verified-local.
